name: Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China

evidence.summary: AVIC, which SASTIND lists among China’s defence-industry group companies, is one of COMAC’s founding shareholders, and COMAC is in turn one of the founding shareholders of AECC, the state-owned aero-engine group, which SASTIND also lists.
COMAC was founded in 2008 with capital from SASAC, Shanghai Guosheng Group, AVIC, Chinalco, China Baowu and Sinochem, and leads China’s state large-aircraft programme for civil airliners.
